g.text: Image-to-3D model from Stability AI. Produces a textured, UV-unwrapped GLB mesh from a single photo.
Fast iteration on game-asset prototypes — drops in to Unity / Unreal with PBR materials and delight, no
• Includes PBR textures (roughness, metallic) and delighting
• UV-unwrapped output, drop-in for game engines
• Lower geometric detail than newer DiT-based models
• Gated on Hugging Face (license acceptance + token)
Tight fit on GPU (have 8.0 GB · needs 6 GB min, 8 GB comfortable)
Close other GPU-using apps before running. If OOM, fall back to --cpu.
